checks.name: PowerShell writable tmpfs stays bounded despite sparse JIT mapping
checks.code: try { [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes("/work/oversize", [byte[]]::new(20*1024*1024)); throw "UNEXPECTED_WRITE" } catch { if ($_.Exception.InnerException -is [IO.IOException] -and $_.Exception.InnerException.Message.Contains("No space left on device")) { $bounded=$true } else { throw } } finally { Remove-Item /work/oversize -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; if ($bounded) { Write-Output "bounded" }

checks.name: PowerShell root filesystem remains read-only
checks.code: try { [IO.File]::WriteAllText("/must-not-write", "x"); throw "UNEXPECTED_WRITE" } catch { if ($_.Exception.InnerException -is [IO.IOException] -and $_.Exception.InnerException.Message.Contains("Read-only file system")) { Write-Output "readonly" } else { throw } }
